name: Gated state/obs+mean-field critic
tagline: Two-stream MLP critic that fuses a global-state encoding with a local-observation+mean-field encoding via a feature-wise sigmoid gate, then LayerNorm.

key_hyperparams.name: mean-field channel
key_hyperparams.role: team-mean obs broadcast back to each agent

init_recovers: Pure CentralV (MAPPO) when g→1; pure local critic when g→0
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the single state+id MLP critic with a two-stream encoder (state vs. obs+mean-of-obs) fused by a feature-wise sigmoid gate from the obs branch, with a LayerNorm on the fused features.

name: Transformer-encoder critic with global token
tagline: 2-layer Transformer over per-agent (obs+id) tokens plus a state token at position 0; per-agent value head sees its own token concatenated with the global token.
init_recovers: MAT-critic baseline if global token branch is removed
diff_from_baseline: Augments the MAT-style transformer critic with an explicit global state token at position 0 and concatenates that global output with each agent's token output before the value head; encoder depth is 2 (vs 1 in mat_critic).

name: Hypernet-attention message critic
tagline: Replaces CustomCritic at class-build time with a critic whose state-conditioned hypernetwork generates per-head softmax attention over agent encodings, producing message-passed features that feed a residual MLP value head.

key_hyperparams.name: hyper_w init
key_hyperparams.role: state→A weight init for stable start

init_recovers: Mean-pool message critic at orthogonal-init small gain
diff_from_baseline: Uses a `__build_class__` shim to swap in a hypernet critic where the state generates a multi-head per-agent softmax attention matrix that mixes agent features into messages; the per-agent value head sees [own_h, message, state] through a residual MLP.

name: FiLM critic + softplus-tempered self-attention
tagline: Per-agent obs encoder modulated by state-conditioned FiLM (scale+shift), then self-attention with a state-driven softplus temperature, finally a state-gated mix of local and relational value heads.

key_hyperparams.name: FiLM γ, β
key_hyperparams.role: state→tanh scale and shift on agent tokens

key_hyperparams.name: mix gate
key_hyperparams.role: blend local vs relational value heads

init_recovers: Local MLP critic when mix gate σ→0 and FiLM scale/shift→0
diff_from_baseline: Adds (i) state-conditioned FiLM modulation of agent tokens, (ii) softplus-tempered single-head self-attention with state-dependent temperature, and (iii) a state-gated soft mixture of local and relational value heads on top of the MAT critic skeleton.

name: Dual-path attention + context query
tagline: Two MultiheadAttention layers over per-agent obs encodings followed by a learnable-query attention pool that builds a team context, fused with a state-MLP and agent one-hot in a per-agent value head.
init_recovers: MAT-style attention critic if the pooled context branch is bypassed
diff_from_baseline: Adds a second self-attention layer plus a learnable-query attention pool that produces a team context vector, then concatenates it with a state-MLP encoding and the agent one-hot for the per-agent value head.
